about: Cost configurations for the host (lab/RESULTS-3.md, the lab's third run, 14 October 2026). "live" is the DEFAULT (NEOLINGO_COSTS unset or "live"): today's costs and curve with the German vocalised-r pairs free (the owner's go, 14 October 21:1x). A host started with NEOLINGO_COSTS=<name> sends the named candidate instead (host/engine_config.apply_candidate). Fields: p = Miolingo's stretch exponent (null: none); F = floor on a substitution that costs anything (0: none); I = the insertion and deletion cost it stands for (the engine's own is fixed at 1000, so every substitution cost and costOtherwise are multiplied by 1000/I and the curve's scale by (1000/I)^2: the same scores); S = the curve's scale as a multiple of the live 2250000; free = [language, target, heard] pairs that cost 0 and are shown as the target (the sound check's warning for such a pair is dropped).

live.describe: today's costs and curve; German espeak [ɜ]/[ɐ] heard as [r]/[ɾ] free (the third run's B, made the default on 14 October)

run3.describe: insertion and deletion 900 instead of 1000 (the third run's choice: the fewest parameters among the candidates the owner's verdicts do not separate from the best), and German espeak [ɜ]/[ɐ] heard as [r]/[ɾ] free (B)

run3-indel.describe: insertion and deletion 900 instead of 1000, nothing else
